items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: In fact one of the ladies just died, it was in the paper the other day, Lily St. Cyr.

ctx.x: Yeah, I can just picture you trying to play your horn and looking up at the showgirls.
In fact one of the ladies just died, it was in the paper the other day, Lily St. Cyr. And what was the other lady, great names. One of the comedians was Yule, Joe Yule, Mickey Rooney’s father.
